jobs.description: EnerGuard Solution Home Solutions EnerGuard Blog About Careers Contact OT cybersecurity, compliance and operational context in one platform EnerGuard helps smart grid operators reduce cost, cut manual work, and strengthen cyber resilience through one platform built for modern grid operations. Book a Demo Estimate Savings What Operators Gain Lower operating cost Reduce the need for additional staffing, recurring consulting support, and multiple point tools. Lower compliance burden Cut time-consuming manual work related to documentation, monitoring, and audit preparation. Better prioritization Focus limited attention and resources on the issues that matter most. Stronger adaptability Keep pace with evolving threats, technologies, and regulations without repeated internal rework. What EnerGuard Delivers EnerGuard is designed to help smart grid operators manage cybersecurity and compliance more efficiently, without relying on a growing mix of specialists, consultants, and disconnected tools. Key Capabilities Asset visibility See and understand connected grid and energy assets across the environment. Threat and anomaly detection Identify suspicious activity and operationally relevant anomalies. Operational prioritization Use operational context to understand which issues matter most to operations and resilience. Compliance support Reduce manual effort around compliance monitoring, evidence, reporting, and audit readiness. Why EnerGuard is different Built for smart grid operators EnerGuard is designed specifically for modern energy environments, including distributed infrastructure, renewable assets, storage systems, EV charging, and other connected grid operations. Operational context built in Most cybersecurity tools focus on technical events alone. EnerGuard adds operational context, helping teams understand the real significance of issues in relation to grid operations, resilience, and continuity. Efficiency, not just detection EnerGuard is built to reduce dependence on scarce expertise, repeated consulting work, and fragmented tooling, helping operators do more with existing teams. Cybersecurity and compliance together Instead of treating compliance as a separate manual burden, EnerGuard helps operators address cybersecurity and compliance in one ongoing workflow. Secure deployment and data control EnerGuard is designed for environments where data security, regulatory requirements, and operational control are critical. AI capabilities can run locally on-premises or in a secure and compliant cloud environment, giving operators the flexibility to protect sensitive data in the way that best fits their security and governance needs. Local deployment Run EnerGuard on-premises, including local AI processing, so sensitive data can remain entirely within the operator’s environment. Secure compliant cloud Where cloud deployment is preferred, EnerGuard can operate in a secure and compliant cloud environment designed to support strict security and regulatory requirements. Protected data handling Sensitive operational and cybersecurity data is secured through strong protection mechanisms aligned with the needs of critical infrastructure operators. Deployment flexibility Whether the requirement is full local control or a compliant hosted environment, EnerGuard can align with the operator’s security model. A more practical model for smart grid cybersecurity EnerGuard helps smart grid operators strengthen cybersecurity and compliance in a more scalable, efficient, and cost-effective way.
